title: Two brothers, one inheritance
body: Arjun and Kabir are identical twins. Several members of their family have suffered from depression, and a doctor has told their parents that both boys may have inherited a biological tendency towards it. After college, Arjun moves alone to a new city. Within a year he loses his job, has no close friends there and faces mounting debts. He begins to feel hopeless, sleeps poorly and loses interest in everything, and is later diagnosed with major depressive disorder. Kabir stays in his home town, works in a steady job and has a supportive family and a close group of friends. He faces no major stressful event during this period and shows no signs of a psychological disorder.

title: Deb's attacks while driving
body: One day while driving home, Deb felt his heart beating rapidly. He started sweating profusely and felt short of breath. He was so scared that he stopped the car and stepped out. Over the next few months these attacks came again and again, without warning, each time rising quickly to a peak of intense terror. Deb became hesitant to drive for fear of being caught in traffic during an attack. He started feeling that he had gone crazy and would die. Soon he remained indoors and refused to move out of the house.
